name: SPIRANTHES AUTUMNALIS
key_symptoms: Sciatic pain, especially right side. Pain in shoulders. Swelling of veins of hands. Pain in all articulations of hands. Coldness of feet and toes.
guiding_symptoms: Sciatic pain, especially right side. Pain in shoulders. Swelling of veins of hands. Pain in all articulations of hands. Coldness of feet and toes.
urinary_symptoms: Pruritus; vulva red; dryness and burning in vagina. Burning pain in vagina during coition. Leucorrhśa, bloody.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Sciatic pain, especially right side. Pain in shoulders. Swelling of veins of hands. Pain in all articulations of hands. Coldness of feet and toes.
fever_symptoms: Flushes of heat. Sweat on palms. Hands alternately hot and cold.
